title: Keep Engram landings possible when the review parent is unavailable: a deputy obtains authentic review results
outcome: Engram's review and landing rules (rules-merger-role clause 2, /review-changes) and its tooling no longer depend on one live session. When the session that commissioned a review is unavailable, an authorized deputy obtains the reviewers' authentic results through a supported read-only route, without retrying the parent or commissioning a duplicate pair, and the landing proceeds.
acceptance: The Engram rule text (rules-merger-role clause 2 and .claude/commands/review-changes.md, with AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md only if needed) names which deputies may obtain review results when the commissioning parent is unavailable (the project coordinator or interim coordinator, the integration owner) and which record proves a result authentic, without accepting a parent's summary or prose in place of a reviewer's own result

The deputy route is read-only: it never mutates the unavailable parent's session, delegation or wait records, and it uses a supported TermAl read path agreed with TermAl (TermAl w-fb35d7e76d72) or an Engram-side durable copy of each reviewer's own result
No single session is the only possible reader of a required review result; the record states what happens when the parent, the deputy or the Merger is unavailable
The rule change lands under the authority-text procedure (a), (b) and (c), and its first real use (or a reproduction of the 2026-10-30 Engram::Fable case) is recorded on this item
disposal_reason: Cancelled by Engram::Fable (coordinator), 2026-11-25. Greg objected to this workaround via Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1929, message 8ca070d2, 2026-11-24 01:27:45Z), verbatim: „Możemy. Ale czemu? Problemy sa z sesja jak musze zmienic subscrypcje. Wtedy generalnie nic nie działa. Takie obejscia nie pomogą.” In the 2026-10-30 case, TermAl's structured-result read blocked the landing, not the Engram text, and during a subscription switch no eligible session exists, so a deputy rule doesn't help. No Engram rule change. The real fix is TermAl w-10daa08df91c (result publication independent of the parent). Candidate c27f1d02 stays unpublished and unlanded.
